lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments observed; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-torso but decreases in density and regularity towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 6th vertical line from the anterior, splitting in the lower ventral quadrant of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant discontinuities are observed in the 3rd, 7th, 8th, and 9th lines, which appear as dashed segments or terminate before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast circular spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, situated superior to the white transverse leg band.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A series of 3 spots aligns in a diagonal downward trajectory across the upper portion of the rear hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate spiral geometry; horns diverge laterally and posterior-superiorly from the skull before curving medially at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated ratio of the terminal tip span to the horn base width is 2.7:1.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory/bright-pixel tipping occupies approximately 12% of the total vertical horn height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible tongue protrusion (glossus) extending laterally from the left side of the oral cavity; a minor V-shaped notch is visible on the superior margin of the left ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright white facial chevron between the orbits; two distinct circular white spots on the lower mandible; prominent white dorsal mane and long dark ventral fringe.
